official.deadline_note: Electronic submission is staggered by the last digit of the identity document used to register on the CONICET intranet: digit 0 closes 01/03/2027, digit 1 on 02/03/2027, digits 2 and 3 on 03/03/2027, digits 4-6 on 04/03/2027 and digits 7-9 on 05/03/2027. Applicants with an expected due date during the call period may request an extension of up to 40 days. Control of applications runs 8-31 March 2027, evaluation April-May 2027, results are published on 1 July 2027 and activities start on 1 August 2027.
official.application_cycle: Convocatoria de Becas 2026 - Becas Internas Postdoctorales, with fellowships starting 01/08/2027
official.status_note: The Convocatoria de Becas 2026 is the call in force on CONICET's site: it provides 1,000 internal doctoral, 300 internal doctoral-completion and 800 internal postdoctoral places. The postdoctoral window runs 18 February to 5 March 2027; the doctoral and doctoral-completion windows ran in July-August 2026 and are closed.
official.tuition_coverage_note: CONICET publishes the fellowship as the payment of a monthly stipend (estipendio mensual), the granting of ART (occupational risk) coverage and, where applicable, the Adicionales por Cobertura Medico Asistencial and por Familia. No payment of tuition or enrolment fees is published for this category, and the bases state that CONICET will not finance airfares, migratory-procedure fees or other relocation costs.
benefits: Monthly stipend for internal postdoctoral fellowships, published by CONICET according to the locality of the workplace: ARS 1,530,138.95 in September 2026, ARS 1,557,681.44 in October 2026, ARS 1,582,604.34 in November 2026 and ARS 1,606,343.42 in December 2026 in the base localities (CABA, GBA, La Plata, Mar del Plata, Rosario, Cordoba capital and most other listed localities).
Higher published values apply in some localities, reaching ARS 1,700,939.41 (Bahia Blanca) and ARS 2,060,404.21 (Ushuaia) in December 2026.
ART (occupational risk) coverage granted to fellows, plus, where applicable, the Adicionales por Cobertura Medico Asistencial and por Familia.

Fellows may add to their stipend the remuneration from a secondary, tertiary or university teaching post within the dedication hours set by the Reglamento de Becas, and may take shifts in health institutions for a maximum of 12 hours per week with the director's agreement and CONICET's authorisation (not simultaneously with teaching posts).

Exclusive dedication to the academic and research tasks of the work plan; the bases state that holding the fellowship does not imply a present or future employment relationship with CONICET and does not include pension contributions.
eligibility: Candidates who have approved their doctoral thesis and wish to improve their academic training or specialty and develop basic or applied research or technological development tasks; the call is not aimed at members of CONICET's Carrera del Investigador.

Only applications from those who have made the definitive submission of the copies of their doctoral thesis or who have defended it; those who have not yet defended must attach the certificate of final submission plus a definitive copy, and the thesis must be defended and approved before the fellowship start date.
Applicants must not have held another CONICET postdoctoral fellowship (internal or external) and must not have the pending start-up (alta) of a fellowship awarded in a previous call.
Only one application per call: simultaneous applications in more than one category and/or modality, or in other CONICET calls, are not admitted.
No kinship up to the third degree between the applicant and the proposed director and/or codirector.
No age limit applies to this category.
Activities must be developed at the centre where the proposed director and/or codirector usually carries out research, with daily attendance certified by the competent authority.
requirements: Application only in electronic form through SIGEVA-CONICET, with the corresponding avals incorporated digitally as an attached file; no printed version is required.
Register as a user of the CONICET intranet and open the application with the role 'Usuario presentacion/Solicitud'.
Research plan of no more than five pages including bibliography, written in Spanish only, respecting the required format (A4, 1.5 cm margins, Arial 11 throughout).
Original work plan: applications repeating a plan already presented in this call or the plan of an active CONICET fellowship are rejected.

Proposed director and/or codirector must meet the bases' conditions (CONICET Carrera del Investigador members in the categories Adjunto, Independiente, Principal or Superior, or equivalent researchers at other institutions; Investigadores/as Asistentes cannot direct postdoctoral fellows; current CONICET fellows cannot be proposed as directors).
Indicate whether the project corresponds to a prioritized theme or an open theme and justify the selection when a prioritized theme is chosen.
documents: Scanned certificate of approval of the doctoral thesis or of the doctorate title; if not yet defended, the certificate of the definitive submission of the thesis copies for evaluation by the corresponding Doctorate (a resolution appointing the jury is accepted only if it states the date the definitive copies were delivered).
Definitive final version of the doctoral thesis for applicants who have not yet defended (an empty Word file is uploaded if the thesis has already been defended).
Research plan in PDF, maximum five pages including bibliography, with the title, abstract and keywords consigned in both Spanish and English.
AVAL form of the proposed workplace, signed with clarification (digital or scanned) by the maximum authority of the institution the workplace depends on, uploaded as PDF.
Curriculum vitae completed in SIGEVA and attached, with full texts of cited works preferably in PDF (only occasionally .doc or .rtf).
Documentation backing every antecedent entered in SIGEVA, since only antecedents correctly recorded at the moment of submission are evaluated.
selection_criteria: Antecedents of the applicant in research and teaching: up to 40 points.
Direction, group and workplace: up to 10 points.
Integral consistency of the presentation between the work plan, the applicant's training, the direction and the workplace: up to 20 points (total 100 points).
Advisory Bodies validate the project's pertinence to a prioritized or open theme and may modify the theme if the proposal falls under a different one.

70% of each Advisory Commission's quota goes to projects matching the prioritized themes or the priority geographic regions and thematic areas matrix; the remaining 30% goes to eligible applicants in the Commission's order of merit, first those matching the priority matrix and then by merit. Unfilled quota is not transferred between Commissions and stays pending for a second round.
coverage: Monthly stipend (estipendio mensual) paid according to the locality of the workplace.
Where applicable, additional amounts for medical-assistance coverage and for family.
application_method: Electronic submission through SIGEVA-CONICET in the staggered window corresponding to the last digit of the identity document used for the intranet registration.
official.application_route: Register on the CONICET intranet, open the postdoctoral call in SIGEVA under the role 'Usuario presentacion/Solicitud', link the proposed director and workplace to generate the AVAL form, complete the CV and upload the PDFs, then send electronically before the closing date assigned to your document digit.
official.study_mode: full-time, exclusive dedication to the academic and research tasks required by the work plan
official.citizenship_residency: Open to Argentine and foreign candidates; work must be carried out at the proposed workplace in Argentina with certified daily attendance, and foreign beneficiaries residing abroad must complete the corresponding migratory procedure to enter Argentina and may not do so as tourists.
official.international_eligibility: Yes - CONICET describes its scholarship programmes as directed at young university graduates, Argentine and foreign, and the bases set out the migratory procedure for foreign awardees living abroad.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Applicants must apply to the Advisory Commission of their discipline and state whether the project corresponds to a prioritized theme of the call (the list includes energy and mining, agroindustry, health, knowledge economy and exact and natural sciences) or to an open theme.
official.research_requirement: A research plan to be carried out during the fellowship, supervised by the proposed director(s), of no more than five pages including bibliography, in Spanish only and in the mandated format; plans exceeding that length or ignoring the format are rejected.
official.description: CONICET's internal postdoctoral fellowships are aimed at candidates who have approved their doctoral thesis and wish to perfect their academic training or specialty while developing basic or applied research or technological development tasks in Argentina, for a maximum of thirty-six months.
official.program_type: National research council postdoctoral fellowship (Beca Interna Postdoctoral)

not_confirmed: No IELTS/TOEFL or medium-of-instruction requirement is published for this call.
No published statement that CONICET pays tuition or enrolment fees for this fellowship.
The stipend value in force when the fellowship starts on 01/08/2027, since CONICET publishes only the September-December 2026 table and updates it periodically.
The quota of postdoctoral places assigned to each Advisory Commission.
verification.notes: Amount read from CONICET's own 'Estipendios de Becas Internas segun localidad del lugar de trabajo' table (postdoctoral column, base localities, December 2026) linked from the official becario page; deadline, eligibility, documents, scoring and schedule read from BASES-PD-2026 and the 2026 presentation instructivo on the convocatorias domain; no third-party source was used for any figure.

applicant_utility.summary: This is CONICET's three-year salaried postdoctoral line: a single application, filed once a year, but the closing date you must hit depends on the last digit of your ID document rather than on the advertised end of the window. The money is a monthly stipend that scales with the city where your director's laboratory sits, and CONICET explicitly funds no flights, visa fees or relocation, so you must finance the move to Argentina yourself. There is no English test, yet the entire work plan has to be in Spanish, with only the title and abstract duplicated in English, which is where many foreign-trained candidates lose time. Competition runs for 800 places and 70% of each commission's quota is reserved for projects mapped onto CONICET's prioritized themes or priority regions, so the framing of your plan matters as much as your publication record.
applicant_utility.best_fit: A recently defended PhD (or one whose final thesis copies are already lodged with the doctorate office) who has a host laboratory and a certified director in Argentina and can write the project inside one of CONICET's prioritized themes.
application_readiness_checklist: Find out now which staggered closing date applies to you from the last digit of your intranet registration document, and work backwards from it: date 0 applicants lose ten days of the nominal window.

Confirm your thesis status and obtain the right certificate early: a defence certificate, or the definitive-submission certificate plus the final thesis copy if the defence is still pending, and be certain the defence will happen before 1 August 2027.

Agree the project with a proposed director and workplace before opening the form, because the AVAL form can only be generated after the director and workplace are linked, and the institution's maximum authority has to sign it.
Check that the proposed director is not a CONICET Investigador/a Asistente, is not a current fellow, and has no outstanding regulatory reports or rejected annual report.

Rewrite your research plan to the mandated format: five pages maximum including bibliography, A4, 1.5 cm margins, Arial 11 everywhere, Spanish throughout, with title, abstract and keywords in both Spanish and English.
Complete and update your SIGEVA record and CV before you send, since nothing entered after submission is evaluated and the CV cannot be edited afterwards.
Decide and justify explicitly whether your project belongs to a prioritized theme or is an open theme, and map it to the right Advisory Commission for your discipline.
common_rejection_risks: Submitting on 5 March when your document digit gave you an earlier date: the staggered cut-offs are enforced and late or incomplete applications are simply not accepted.
A work plan over five pages, in a different font size or margin, or written in English, all of which are grounds for outright rejection before academic evaluation.
Reusing the same plan as an active CONICET fellowship or duplicating a plan inside this call, which is rejected at administrative control or withdrawn during evaluation.
An AVAL form that is missing, unsigned or signed by the wrong authority, since the endorsement of the workplace is a required attachment.
A director who is a CONICET assistant investigator, a current fellow, in arrears with reports, or related to you within the third degree.
Applying while holding or having held another CONICET postdoctoral fellowship, or with a previous award still pending start-up.
Assuming an application in another category or another CONICET call can run in parallel: simultaneous presentations are not admitted.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Relocation to Argentina: the bases exclude airfares, migratory-procedure fees and other transfer costs, and foreign awardees must regularise their migration status rather than enter as tourists. Beyond that, any living costs above the monthly stipend in the host city, and the portion of research costs (equipment, consumables, fieldwork, conference travel, publication fees) that the host institution's own projects do not already cover.
document_audit: The AVAL form is only downloadable inside SIGEVA after you have linked your proposed director and selected the workplace, so leaving the profile incomplete until the last days blocks the signature you need from the dean or unit director.

Thesis proof has a trap: if you have not defended, you must upload both the definitive-submission certificate and the final version of the thesis, and the certificate of jury formation is only accepted when it states the date the definitive copies were delivered.
Applicants who already defended upload an empty Word file in the thesis slot; forgetting to fill the field at all can leave the application incomplete.

Full texts of cited works are expected, preferably as PDF, and antecedents are scored only if properly recorded in SIGEVA at the moment of submission, so an un-updated CV silently costs you points on the 40-point antecedents dimension.
No printed copy is required, but every attachment must be PDF, and the sworn declaration you sign at submission makes the avals and attached documents legally binding.
alerts: The fellowship starts on 1 August 2027, so an applicant defending in the first half of 2027 must have the defence and approval completed before that date, not merely before applying.

Current CONICET doctoral or doctoral-completion fellows of cohorts 2021/2027, 2022/2027 and 2025/2027 receive an automatic extension of their existing fellowship until the postdoctoral results are published, and until it takes effect if they win, which protects the gap between awards.

Applicants with an expected childbirth date during the call may request a 40-day extension, and a maternity extension of a current doctoral fellowship shifts the postdoctoral start until that period ends.
Once awarded, the place of work and director cannot be changed for one year, so the host choice made during the application is effectively locked in.
Stipend values are periodically revised by locality, so the peso amounts CONICET publishes now will not be the amounts paid at the start of the fellowship in a high-inflation economy.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register on the CONICET intranet, open the postdoctoral call in SIGEVA under the 'Usuario presentacion/Solicitud' role, link the proposed director and workplace to unlock the AVAL form, complete the form, CV and PDF attachments, generate the application summary PDF that names your managing unit, and press send before 23:59 on your document-digit closing date.
